profile.headline: Run it
profile.summary:
IT industry professional with solid and extensive experience in software development, support, and data analysis.  Experience in small business environment to understand all aspects of software business and in big business to understand structure and process.  Technical background provides outstanding foundation to build on, combined with success in applying knowledge in very practical way to achieve company objectives. Key strength in ability to pick things up quickly and work with minimal supervision.  Passion for new technologies.  

Specialties:  .Net Development

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Work in a software development team that does everything needed to create a patient estimate used in the  healthcare system software used in hospitals.  I am currently working as a Team Lead in a scrum process.

•	I help with production support in research, code fixes and enhancements whenever needed.
•	I help mentor new hires to get familiar with our process and rules.
•	I work with product, design, and architect teams to help shape the new technologies needed.
•	I do code reviews and help out all other devs to learn the business rules and proper coding standards.
•	I monitor progress of other devs on the team and try to maintain and help them reach their sprint goals.
•	I write and help define lot of our jira tickets so they are ready for development.
•	I am the DevOps representative of our team and work with DevOps to keep our code up to date with security standards.
•	I rewrote backend processing or our software line for a more streamlined process and am building lot of the framework of our further development.
•	I moved all our containers to AWS EKS from Openshift and am helping our current framework to be more microservices on the cloud.
•	I started a new React application which will be our new platform for the web.
•	Helped setup RabbitMQ process flows onPrem and in AWS.
•	I use Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, Bamboo, Octopus, Sonar, Veracode
•	Work in .Net with MVS, Angular, React, Jquery, Web, Webservices, Window Services and Desktop clients and SQL backend

positions.title: Software Developer Team Lead
positions.description:
I worked as a team lead for a scrum group of five that worked on all software aspects of the company.  Mostly worked with .Net technologies and SQL Server back end.  Worked with Angular.  I also worked on building and deploying software from all environment with TFS and Octopus.  Worked with organizing team capacities to mentoring junior developers as well as designing new architectures and better ways to improve existing systems.  Worked with managing queues with RabbitMQ.

Programming in VB.Net,  Asp.Net Core, Angular, Typescript, WinForms, WebSites, WebAPIs, MVC

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
I worked in a SCRUM environment with a team of 9 doing two week sprints.  We are a Proof of Concept group of our company.  We dealt mostly in websites and the iOS world.  

Mobile - iOS
We have developed many iPhone apps internally and one currently that is public called Mugshots.  We use .Net API/webservices to access our SQL Server as our backend.  We use Jenkins as our build control system and Testflight for testing our betas.  We have made many differing apps using such functionalities as  barcode scanning, camera, photo gallery, social media integration, multi language support, and many others. 

.NET Websites 
We have many internal and public websites.  They all use SQL Server database.  We use MVC and C# for the most part.  cars.iaai.com is one of the public sites we built and maintain.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
.Net Programming for ERP system.
Winform & Web Development
.Net 4.0 framework with WCF

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Worked on all websites from intranet, internet, and extranet using C# on .NET  framework.  Maintained and upgraded all facets of environment.  Used SQL Server as backend database and MCMS as content management system.  Used Visual SourceSafe and TFS to store and version code.  Undertook numerous projects to take advantage of newer, more efficient, and more effective technologies:
Worked heavily with project managers, graphic designers, network engineers, and end users to design, modify, and implement web sites and features from start to finish.
 

Developed program for Telephone Entry Systems using Visual Basic 6.0 called Versa XS.  Program ran on desktop pcs and used to communicate to TES units over modem or serial ports:  extended project filled with research, testing, deployment, and upgrades.  Took this software from all stages all the way to deployment.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Software Engineer, Implementation Specialist, Independent Consultant
Member of small, elite unit formed to provide laser print solutions to clients.  Researched, developed, implemented, and supported laser and thermo printing software solutions for large corporations, hospitals, and government entities nationwide on various platforms.  Also provided specialized training sessions for all company software packages. 

Project:   PrintMerge (2000-2005)
Primary printing software used with any business software solution.  Formatted and printed any data file to any laser or thermo printer on network.   Key role to evolve software as needed, and heavily involved in all parts of business.  Involved in everything from heavily detailed bit-by-bit coding to sales support.

Worked on many thoughtful innovations with management, clients, and co-workers to explore new software products and markets

positions.title: Database Specialist
positions.description:
Credit report agency and data warehousing company.
Database Specialist
Ran database production programs on mainframe with scheduled deadlines.  Altered systems and programs for efficiency and accuracy.  Made flowcharts, spec sheets, and checklists for records.  Worked heavily with proprietary languages, JCL, and TSO / ISPF.  Worked together with sales reps, analysts, specialists, and managers to perform variety of projects.

projects.title: Woof Rescue iPhone App
projects.description: iOS developer and business development of a company which helps people find the love of their lives at their local pet shelter. The first app for the company offers a national database of over 100,000 adoptable pets, which are presented in a fun and informative fashion.
